exposure: Prenatal diagnosis of isolated axillary lymphatic malformation
cohort: 8 fetuses with the prenatal diagnosis of isolated axillary lymphatic malformation detected between 2009 and 2013
finding: Prenatally diagnosed isolated axillary lymphatic malformations are usually not associated with adverse fetal outcomes and can be managed postnatally with surgery, sclerotherapy, or observation, but recurrence and residual disease are common.
